scope: Independent no-key public web_search module, persistent search ledger and CLI diagnostic
user_direction: Prefer public search without an API key; stop explicitly on access restrictions.

live_probe.method: Single pre-integration urllib GET with redirects disabled and transparent agent user-agent

offline_verification.method: Synthetic HTML, controlled providers, mocked sockets/streams and real local Python subprocesses without network access
verified_behaviors: Registry validates input/output and web_search capability before any reservation or network request.
Fixed HTTPS endpoint, no redirects, no automatic retries, first page only, one attempt per new request.
Search endpoint DNS is checked and pinned; TLS verification and provider SNI remain enabled for direct and configured proxy routes.
HTTP and proxy CONNECT access restrictions stop with SEARCH_ACCESS_RESTRICTED; no body or raw provider error is exposed.
Response body and worker output are bounded; process creation and network exchange share the deadline.
Timeout, cancellation and output overflow terminate and reap the network subprocess; it is not an AI subagent.
512-character UTF-8 queries are transmitted without JSON truncation; ASCII and C1 controls are rejected.
Only explicit no-results HTML returns an empty success; challenges and unknown layouts are errors.
Search hits are deduplicated, ranked and marked evidence_eligible=false; no Source or Evidence is generated.
Persistent intent and per-task quota are reserved atomically before provider execution; failed and uncertain attempts remain charged.
Completed success/error replays do not make new provider calls; altered, cross-task or unresolved request IDs are rejected.
CLI exposes task/request IDs even on failure; stdout is ToolResult JSON and stderr carries the IDs.
Other commands do not construct the search ledger or contact a search provider.

fixed_findings: Escaped Unicode input could exceed worker stdin limit.
Shielded process creation could outlive the request deadline.
Proxy CONNECT access restrictions were misclassified as network failures.
communicate collected full stdout before checking the output limit.
independent_review.extra_checks: Actual offline Python children were terminated and reaped on timeout and external cancellation.
